dedupe_keys.name: southern new zealand wrf weather simulation 2005 2020

description: The World Data Center for Climate publishes a selected 16-year Weather Research and Forecasting simulation for the Southern Alps of New Zealand. Its current record says WRF 4.2.2 was forced by ERA5 every three hours in nested 10 km and 2 km domains. The public CC BY 4.0 archive provides selected daily NetCDF fields from the 2 km inner domain for 2005–2020. The article lists 47 mostly atmospheric variables and notes that other domains or higher-frequency output require author request. These gridded fields can supply rain, temperature and wind boundary conditions for flood, road and electricity-exposure simulations in the South Island. They are model output, not direct station measurements, and mountain topography can leave local bias. Users should distinguish the available daily subset from the fuller simulation described in the methods. It complements data-era5-reanalysis, its coarser forcing source. No NetCDF file was downloaded.
